channel.title: Version 8 :: Cap'n Hugo Relearrrn Theme
channel.description: 8.3.0 (2025-11-27) Cap'n Hugo 0.141.0 0.141.0 This release requires a newer Cap'n Hugo version. Change Change Th' children shortcode has changed th' way it picks an image if displayed as card. Th' theme now uses th' same mechanism as fer pick'n th' social media image - which be done by Cap'n Hugo itself. Ye may have t' adjust th' file name o' yer preview image accordingly.
